job.question: In the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP for investment consultant services, how long is the chosen consultant expected to be retained?
job.expected_facts: For five (5) years, not to exceed seven (7) years including any renewal, extension or option. The Board can terminate on thirty (30) days written notice.
job.acceptance: Five years and seven-year total ceiling including renewals/extensions/options. Thirty-day termination is optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Illinois Teachers’ Retirement System RFP, not the Shrewsbury Contributory Retirement System RFP. Its sample agreement mentions a term of up to five years but expressly prohibits extensions; it does not support the required seven-year ceiling including renewals, extensions, or options.
quotes: Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT CONSULTANT SERVICES
The professional services under this Agreement shall be provided between date of execution and December 31, 2029 (not to exceed five years) unless earlier
The term of this Agreement may not be extended.
